Name: Albion Parsnip G3 and Jojasoft Workstation - Computer Furniture Pack
Author: serenityfrost
Description:
[size=3]Bring the golden age of beige boxes and pixelated promise to your farmhouse with this nostalgic furniture mod.

This mod adds two sleek and functional computer sets to your farmhouse, workshop, or any space in need of a technological boost (brought to you by the Parsnip Institute and the ever-efficient JojaSoft Division).

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Albion Parsnip G3 – A sleek, fruit-themed desktop computer favored by artists, students, and forward-thinkers across the valley. Comes in a variety of translucent casing colors for maximum personality.[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][*][size=3]Jojasoft Workstation – A bulky, corporate-grade PC ideal for spreadsheets, solitaire, or reporting monthly crop and produce quotas from home. Standard across JojaCorp offices, now available for home use.[/size]
[/list][size=3][left]﻿[/left][center]<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>:<:>[/center][/size][size=3]
Features:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]🖥️ Two distinct computer setups (both with and without clutter) in a plethora of computer and desk colors.[/size]
[*][size=3]📺 All variations function as in-game TVs.[/size]
[*][size=3]☎️ A home catalog for built in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
